lines.beaver: 수진 씨, 저한테 물어볼 게 있다고 했죠?
lines.beaver_en: Sujin, you said you had something to ask me?
lines.beaver_roman: sujin ssi, jeohante mureobol ge itdago haetjyo?
lines.learner: 네, 행사 공고문을 쓰고자 하는데 절차를 몰라서요.
lines.en: Yes, I want to write an event notice, but I don't know the steps.
lines.roman: ne, haengsa gonggomuneul sseugoja haneunde jeolchareul mollaseoyo.

lines.beaver: 먼저 정해진 양식에 내용을 써야 해요.
lines.beaver_en: First, you need to write it on the set form.
lines.beaver_roman: meonjeo jeonghaejin yangsige naeyongeul sseoya haeyo.
lines.en: Can I use regular paper for the form?

lines.beaver: 아니요, 회사 로고가 있는 용지를 써야 해요.
lines.beaver_en: No, you have to use paper with the company logo.
lines.beaver_roman: aniyo, hoesa rogoga inneun yongjireul sseoya haeyo.
lines.learner: 알겠어요. 다 쓰면 바로 공고하면 되나요?
lines.en: Got it. Can I post the notice right after writing it?
lines.roman: algesseoyo. da sseumyeon baro gonggohamyeon doenayo?

lines.beaver: 아니요, 먼저 팀장님 결재를 받아야 해요.
lines.beaver_en: No, you need to get the manager's approval first.
lines.beaver_roman: aniyo, meonjeo timjangnim gyeoljaereul badaya haeyo.
lines.en: I see. I'll submit it for approval today.

lines.beaver_en: Good. Will you let other departments know too?
lines.en: Yes, I plan to send an official document in writing.

lines.beaver_en: Good. If it's urgent, you can fax it too.
lines.learner: 팩스로 보낼 때 원본은 어떻게 해요?
lines.en: When I fax it, what do I do with the original?
lines.roman: paekseuro bonael ttae wonboneun eotteoke haeyo?

lines.beaver_en: You must keep the original in the document room.
lines.learner: 네, 원본은 잃어버리지 않게 잘 둘게요.
lines.en: Okay, I'll keep the original safe so it doesn't get lost.
lines.roman: ne, wonboneun ireobeoriji anke jal dulgeyo.

lines.learner: 행사 책자에도 공고 내용을 넣고자 해요.
lines.en: I'd like to put the notice in the event booklet too.
lines.roman: haengsa chaekjaedo gonggo naeyongeul neokoja haeyo.

lines.beaver: 좋은 생각이에요. 책자는 다음 주에 나와요.
lines.beaver_en: Good idea. The booklet comes out next week.
lines.beaver_roman: joeun saenggagieyo. chaekjaneun daeum jue nawayo.
lines.en: Then I should finish the notice before that.

lines.beaver: 네, 모르는 게 있으면 언제든 물어보세요.
lines.beaver_en: Yes, ask me anytime if you're unsure.
lines.beaver_roman: ne, moreuneun ge isseumyeon eonjedeun mureoboseyo.
lines.learner: 고마워요. 덕분에 이제 척척 할 수 있겠어요.
lines.en: Thanks. Thanks to you, I can handle it smoothly now.
lines.roman: gomawoyo. deokbune ije cheokcheok hal su itgesseoyo.
